text: 上海链家研究院数据显示，十一假期（10/1-10/7）上海链家的二手房成交量同比2025年十一假期增长44%，新房成交量增长64%。值得关注的是，带看量增幅低于成交量增幅，这一“剪刀差”释放出关键信号——当前购房者决策效率明显提升，观望情绪减弱，成交意愿较去年更为坚定。上海链家研究院认为，这说明在政策环境优化与价格预期趋稳的背景下，刚需与改善型需求正加速入场，市场信心修复进入实质性阶段。政策端持续释放的宽松信号，正逐步转化为真实的购买力，前期一系列限购松绑、信贷支持等措施的累积效应开始显现。
text_en: Data from Shanghai Lianjia Research Institute shows that during the National Day holiday (10/1-10/7), Shanghai Lianjia's second-hand home transaction volume increased 44% year-on-year compared with the 2025 National Day holiday, while new home transaction volume increased 64%. Notably, the increase in property viewing volume was lower than the increase in transaction volume, and this "scissors gap" releases a key signal — current homebuyers' decision-making efficiency has clearly improved, wait-and-see sentiment has weakened, and transaction willingness is firmer than last year. Shanghai Lianjia Research Institute believes this shows that under the background of an optimized policy environment and stabilizing price expectations, rigid and upgrade demand is accelerating entry, and market confidence repair has entered a substantive stage. Continued easing signals from the policy side are gradually translating into real purchasing power, and the cumulative effects of a series of earlier measures such as relaxed purchase restrictions and credit support are beginning to show.
